summary: Prefer an implicitly piped guest JSON document over ambient TEXAS_ROADHOUSE_GUEST_* values while retaining explicit source precedence.
reason: A shell can retain stale guest environment values; letting them suppress a supplied pipe can select the wrong guest. Environment values remain fallback fields, while --guest-file and confirmed private flags remain explicit sources.
validated_outcome: The implicit-pipe regression test proves piped guest fields override ambient environment values without changing --guest-file precedence.
